issue.title: Fridge door won't close

intake.title: Fridge door won't close
intake.description: My refrigerator door does not close fully. A milk carton may be in the way. I do not know the model.

guidance.reason: AI guidance is unavailable. You can use the safe checks below or prepare a help request.

outcome.title: Check why the fridge door won’t close
outcome.summary: Start with anything preventing the door from closing normally. We won’t assume there is a cooling fault.
outcome.next: If the problem persists, your service request will include the checks already completed.

step.title: Check whether the door closes fully
step.detail: Move any container that prevents the door closing normally. Look for an obvious gap; do not force the door or remove its parts. Keep perishable food safe while cooling is uncertain.
step.why: A blocked door allows warm air in. Correcting an obstruction is a simple first check.
